- Bacon (cooked, pan-fried): 22 g × 540 kcal/100 g ≈ 119 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A small breakfast portion of two melon-pieces-worth of fruit and a few bacon strips is plausible at roughly 55 to 60 g and 130 kcal. The bacon dominates the energy because of its fat content.
